description: (0.5.0) Rollback and equivocation within a series (RFC-ACDP-0020 §5.3). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

expected.behavior: After accepting serial 7 the consumer persists floor 7 for the pin.
Only serial 5 (valid, unexpired, still trusting a registry serial 7 dropped) is presented later: it is below the floor and is not used; the pin is list_invalid with reason rollback.
Serial 8 arrives: it is selected and the floor moves to 8.
Two valid versions with serial 8 and different content_hash: the pin is list_invalid (equivocation) and the consumer alerts.
A valid serial 9 arrives after D: it is selected and the pin is usable again.
The same serial-8 body seen from two registries (different ctx_id, same content_hash) is not equivocation.
